label: Synthesized anti-colonial psychology with Salish Indigenous feminist healing
description: In I Am Woman, Maracle interrogated how settler colonialism produces internalized lateral violence and patriarchal shame among Indigenous nations.
dialecticalTension: Unites Fanonian decolonization with Stó:lō oral philosophy.

label: Mentored Nishnaabeg feminist resurgence through Salish storywork and oratory
description: Leanne Betasamosake Simpson credits Lee Maracle’s Indigenous feminist theory and storywork as foundational to her own radical resurgence praxis.
dialecticalTension: Transmits Indigenous feminist orality from Stó:lō to Nishnaabeg philosophy.
